login.title: Sign in to ICANN RDRS
login.intro: Use your own ICANN account. Jaddar signs in to ICANN on your behalf and keeps the session only for as long as you are working; your password is never stored.
login.privacyNote: Your credentials are sent to ICANN to establish the session and are not saved by Jaddar.
login.mfaPrompt: Enter the verification code from your ICANN multi-factor device.
login.assignedAddress: Your assigned Jaddar RDRS address, as registered with ICANN.

form.lookupHint: ICANN must look the domain up before a request can be sent — this identifies the registrar of record.
form.name: Full name
form.expeditedReason: Why does this need expedited review?
form.expeditedDisclaimer: marking a request expedited does not oblige the registrar to respond faster. In an emergency, contact the registrar directly.
form.confidentiality: Request confidentiality (the registrar will be notified; this is voluntary)
form.processedCountries: Countries where the data will be processed
form.processedCountriesHint: Where you, or the party you represent, will process the data if the registrar discloses it — including any third party or cloud provider acting on your behalf.
form.asciiOnly: ICANN accepts standard ASCII characters only in this field.
form.assertLegalBasis: I am asserting a legal basis for this request
form.partyRepresentation: Who are you submitting on behalf of?
form.powerOfAttorneyHint: A statement from the party you represent confirming you act for them in this request.
form.lawEnforcementQuestion: Has a law enforcement request for data — a subpoena, court order, warrant or other legal request — been issued requesting disclosure of this data?

review.title: Review your request
review.ack1: I acknowledge that the information I have provided is correct.
review.ack2: I affirm that I will process and transfer any disclosed data in compliance with applicable law.

rdrsRegistration.title: Register with ICANN RDRS
rdrsRegistration.intro: Jaddar has generated a dedicated email address for your ICANN account. Register it with ICANN and all RDRS correspondence will arrive in Jaddar, where you can read it under RDRS Messages.
rdrsRegistration.addressHint: Use this exact address as the email on your ICANN Account. Click Copy, or select the field and copy it yourself.
rdrsRegistration.step2: Open ICANN account registration and sign up using that address as your email.
rdrsRegistration.step3: Confirm below once ICANN has accepted your registration.
rdrsRegistration.mailNote: ICANN will send a verification email to this address. It will appear in your RDRS Messages in Jaddar, usually within a couple of minutes.
rdrsRegistration.confirmFailed: Could not record your registration. Please try again.
rdrsRegistration.selectedHint: Address selected — press Ctrl+C (⌘C on Mac) to copy it.

rdrsMailSettings.title: RDRS Mail Capture
rdrsMailSettings.intro: ICANN and registrar correspondence sent to Jaddar RDRS addresses is captured and stored here. Mailgun keeps inbound mail for only a few days, so Jaddar is the durable copy and this retention setting governs it.
rdrsMailSettings.notConfigured: Mail capture is not configured on this server — set MAILGUN_API_KEY to enable it. Until then no correspondence is being captured.
rdrsMailSettings.indefiniteNote: Messages are kept indefinitely. Because requestors register a Jaddar address as their ICANN Account email, this is often their only copy of that correspondence.
rdrsMailSettings.purgeNote: Messages older than {{days}} days are deleted automatically each night, and cannot be recovered.
rdrsMailSettings.purgeDisabled: Nothing to purge while retention is indefinite.
